facts.fact: GSMA states the Abuja Ministerial Declaration on Meaningful Connectivity for Africa was made by ministers and heads of delegation at the ATU Conference of Plenipotentiaries in Abuja, dated 2026-07-24, committing African governments to meaningful connectivity and technology-neutral regulation.

Nigeria's communications ministry, with the ministries of Togo, Kenya, Namibia and Benin and with GSMA and companies, announced the ATLAS Umoja AI initiative on 2026-07-24 at the ATU conference; Nigerian, Namibian and Togolese ministers are said to have committed support, with no signed agreement described.

systems.owner: GSMA with governments of Benin, Kenya, Namibia, Nigeria, Togo
